name: sellora-ai
description: Sellora AI — AI-Powered WhatsApp Sales & Commerce Automation

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sellora/shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @sellora/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @sellora/api" "npm run dev -w @sellora/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sellora/shared && npm run build -w @sellora/api && npm run build -w @sellora/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @sellora/api && npm run lint -w @sellora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sellora/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sellora/api && npm run typecheck -w @sellora/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sellora/shared && npm run test -w @sellora/api
